boards.title: Your First Weekend at Fairfield University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A flexible, under-21-safe sequence for learning the campus, sharing a meal, finding student resources, and sampling Fairfield’s arts, recreation, reflection, and athletics.

cards.title: 1 — Pick Up the Self-Guided Route
cards.subtitle: Begin outside the Kelley Center
cards.notes: Find the red mailboxes outside the Kelley Center entrances, take a route map, and use its marked stops to learn the campus layout.
cards.short_summary: Start with Fairfield’s official self-guided campus route.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield states that self-guided-tour maps with a suggested route and facts about each stop are available in red mailboxes outside the Kelley Center entrances.
cards.access_notes: Maps are described as being outside the Kelley Center entrances; availability is not guaranteed.

cards.title: 2 — Find the Stag Statue
cards.subtitle: Add a recognizable campus landmark to the route
cards.notes: Use the self-guided route to locate the named Stag Statue, then take a group photo without climbing on or obstructing the monument.
cards.short_summary: Mark the weekend with a photo at Fairfield’s named stag landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield’s official campus-visits page identifies and depicts the Stag Statue as a campus-tour feature.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark; follow posted campus access rules and avoid interfering with scheduled tours.

cards.title: 3 — Map Out the Library
cards.subtitle: Locate study spaces and practical services
cards.notes: Open the library’s digital maps, identify a future study area, and note where to find collections or student services before classes begin.
cards.short_summary: Turn a first library visit into a practical orientation stop.
cards.evidence_claim: The library’s official page provides digital maps for exploring its collections, spaces, and services, along with links to current hours and policies.
cards.access_notes: Consult the library’s current-hours link before visiting; this source does not establish fixed weekend hours.

cards.title: 4 — Share a Meal at the Tully
cards.subtitle: Fourth floor of the Barone Campus Center
cards.notes: Meet at the Barone Campus Center, head to the fourth floor, and compare the available stations before choosing a meal together.
cards.short_summary: Use Fairfield’s main dining room as the weekend’s shared meal stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield identifies Tully Dining Commons as an all-you-care-to-eat student restaurant on the fourth floor of the Barone Campus Center with multiple dining stations.
cards.access_notes: Entry requires a meal plan or paid one-time admission; verify the current dining schedule before going.

cards.title: 5 — Browse the Art Museum
cards.subtitle: A Saturday-friendly cultural stop when galleries are open
cards.notes: Choose either the Bellarmine Hall Galleries or Walsh Gallery, check the exhibition listing, and allow time to examine a few works closely.
cards.short_summary: Pause for a free, reservation-free gallery visit on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum states that admission is always free, reservations are unnecessary, and both the Bellarmine Hall Galleries and Walsh Gallery are open Saturdays from 11 a.m. to 4 p.m.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Fairfield University Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Saturday hours are 11 a.m.–4 p.m.; the museum closes for University holidays and inclement weather.

cards.entity_name: Leslie C. Quick, Jr. Recreation Complex
cards.title: 6 — Learn the RecPlex
cards.subtitle: Try a low-key recreation break
cards.notes: Bring your StagCard, tour the available exercise areas, and choose an activity suited to your experience and the facility’s posted rules.
cards.short_summary: Get acquainted with the student recreation complex before the week starts.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield describes the RecPlex as including cardio and strength areas, an indoor track, field-house courts, a pool, and group-fitness spaces.
cards.access_notes: Use is restricted to members who present a membership card or StagCard; verify current facility hours and closures.

cards.title: 7 — Walk the Examen Trail
cards.subtitle: Begin on the Egan Chapel plaza
cards.notes: Follow the five marked rocks along the mile-long route, using each plaque as a quiet prompt for reflection on the weekend so far.
cards.short_summary: Take a structured reflection walk through campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield documents a mile-long Walking Examen beginning at Egan Chapel Plaza and marked by five large rocks representing five movements of the Examen prayer.
cards.source_title: Programs We Offer | Murphy Center for Ignatian Spirituality
cards.access_notes: Outdoor route; use daylight and suitable weather, remain on established paths, and follow campus notices.

cards.title: 8 — Check the Mahoney Arena Schedule
cards.subtitle: Choose a Stags home event if one fits the weekend
cards.notes: Review the official athletics schedule, select a basketball or volleyball home event, and confirm ticket and entry details before leaving.
cards.short_summary: Add an on-campus Stags event when the live schedule allows.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield identifies Mahoney Arena as the home venue for the Stags men’s basketball, women’s basketball, and volleyball programs.
cards.access_notes: Event availability, start time, admission, and arena policies vary; confirm them on the official athletics schedule.

cards.entity_name: Regina A. Quick Center for the Arts
cards.title: 9 — See What’s On at the Quick
cards.subtitle: Pick a performance, lecture, or screening
cards.notes: Scan the Quick Center’s current program, choose an age-appropriate event that fits the group, and secure any required tickets in advance.
cards.short_summary: Use Fairfield’s arts calendar for an evening campus program.
cards.evidence_claim: The Quick Center’s official site publishes dated programs including theatre broadcasts, lectures, and live performances with ticket links.
cards.source_title: Home Page | Fairfield University Quick Center for the Arts
cards.access_notes: Hours and admission depend on the selected program; consult its event page for age guidance and ticket requirements.

cards.entity_name: Egan Chapel of St. Ignatius Loyola
cards.title: 10 — Wind Down at Campus Ministry
cards.subtitle: A late-open student space in Egan Chapel’s lower level
cards.notes: Finish in the Campus Ministry rooms with a quiet conversation and a hot drink, leaving the shared space orderly for the next group.
cards.short_summary: Close the weekend in a welcoming student lounge open until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield states that Campus Ministry’s comfortable student rooms are on Egan Chapel’s lower level, offer free coffee, tea, and snacks, and open daily from 6 a.m. to midnight.
cards.source_title: Our Staff | Fairfield University Campus Ministry
cards.access_notes: The student spaces are currently listed as open daily from 6 a.m. to midnight; observe chapel activities and posted access notices.
